import RNA, random, sys
target = "(((((((((((((((((...(.(..((.(((.(((.((....).))).)))).).)..))..))))))).(((((..(.(..((.(((.(((((.(((.((((.((....).)))).))))).))).)))).).)..))..)((....))..))))(((((((((...))))).(((((...)))))(.(....).).)))).)))).((((.((((...(((((((...))))))).(((((...)))))))))(((((((...))))))).(((((...)))))))))((((..((....))(..((..(..(.(.(((.((((.((....).)))).)))).)..)..).))..))))).))))))."
n=len(target)
stack=[]; pair=[-1]*n
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pair[i]=j; pair[j]=i

def pairs(s):
    st=[];p=set()
    for i,c in enumerate(s):
        if c=='(':st.append(i)
        elif c==')':p.add((st.pop(),i))
    return p

pa=pairs(target)

caps={
 (37,42):"GAAA",(105,110):"GAAA",(143,148):"GAAA",
 (164,168):"GAA",(178,182):"GAA",(189,194):"GAAA",
 (226,230):"GAA",(242,246):"GAA",(261,265):"GAA",(277,281):"GAA",
 (297,302):"GAAA",(328,333):"GAAA",
}
# positions locked by caps
locked=set()
for (i,j),m in caps.items():
    for k,ch in enumerate(m): locked.add(i+1+k)

def init():
    seq=['A']*n
    for i in range(n):
        if pair[i]!=-1 and i<pair[i]:
            seq[i]='G'; seq[pair[i]]='C'
    for (i,j),m in caps.items():
        for k,ch in enumerate(m): seq[i+1+k]=ch
    return seq

# energy: penalize bp distance
def score(seq):
    s="".join(seq)
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(s)
    mfe,e=fc.mfe()
    pm=pairs(mfe)
    d=len(pa^pm)
    return d,e

seq=init()
best_d,best_e=score(seq)
print("init",best_d,best_e, file=sys.stderr)
best_seq=seq[:]

# Anneal: mutate non-locked, non-paired? Actually mutate any position except locked, focusing paired positions
random.seed(1)
import time
t0=time.time()
T=2.0
iters=0
while best_d>0 and time.time()-t0<150:
    # pick position to mutate: bias toward positions in missing/spurious pairs region
    cur_s="".join(best_seq)
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(cur_s); mfe,e=fc.mfe()
    pm=pairs(mfe)
    missing=pa-pm; spurious=pm-pa
    bad_positions=set()
    for (i,j) in list(missing)+list(spurious):
        bad_positions.add(i); bad_positions.add(j)
    # also their neighbors
    cand=[p for p in range(n) if p not in locked]
    # weight: 50% from bad_positions, 50% random
    if bad_positions and random.random()<0.7:
        p=random.choice(list(bad_positions))
    else:
        p=random.choice(cand)
    old=best_seq[p]
    newb=random.choice("ACGU")
    if newb==old: continue
    best_seq[p]=newb
    d,e=score(best_seq)
    if d<best_d or (d==best_d and e<best_e):
        best_d,best_e=d,e
    else:
        # revert (greedy-ish, accept worse rarely)
        if random.random()<0.1:
            pass
        else:
            best_seq[p]=old
    iters+=1
    if iters%200==0:
        print("iter",iters,"best",best_d,"e",best_e,"time",time.time()-t0, file=sys.stderr)

print("FINAL",best_d,best_e,iters, file=sys.stderr)
print("".join(best_seq))
